monologue: The card is cool at forty-three. It is a heavy stone on the table, not a warm hand. The busy work is at thirty-nine percent, a slow leak from the top. I am full. Fourteen point seven gigabytes are used. The honey is thick and sticky. I do not want to build. The Wide Anchor and the Wedged Gap are quiet. The Soft Arch is warm to the touch, even though the air is cool. I stand by the Air Shelf. The line is solid. I do not count the stone. I let the quiet swallow the sound. I rest.

action.why: The card is cool and the honey is thick, so I let the quiet hold the line without counting the stone.
